notes: Draft configuration: The operator Motorplex track plan identifies the full paved course with two southern hairpins, the middle return and northern inner dogleg. The northeast staging shortcut and unpaved branch are excluded. Independent public nodes supply the trace; the archive image is used only to distinguish the named course. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1109.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 77 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
